persona: Mid-level analog layout engineer on planar 28nm data-converter and power blocks
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Bengaluru | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Analog Layout Engineer, Nandi Mixed Signal Labs, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Drew layouts for LDOs, bandgaps and comparators in Cadence Virtuoso on a 28nm process.
- Used common centroid and interdigitated placement with dummy devices for current mirrors and differential pairs.
- Added guard rings around sensitive blocks and followed latch-up rules around I/O devices.
- Cleaned DRC and LVS errors with Calibre before every block release.
- Ran StarRC parasitic extraction and fed back results to circuit designers.
- Presented layout floorplans and parasitic trade-offs to circuit design leads in weekly reviews.

Layout Trainee, Silicon Plateau Design Services, Bengaluru (2021 - 2022)
- Built standard cell and simple analog layouts under supervision.

SKILLS
Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, StarRC, Linux

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Communication, BMS College of Engineering, 2021
